author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
body: DetectNullPropagatingNodes currently treats all binary operators except AndAlso/OrElse as null-propagating. This includes ExpressionType.Coalesce, which is not null-propagating (e.g., COALESCE(a, '') can be non-null even when a is null). That can cause DropNotNullChecks to incorrectly remove a IS NOT NULL predicates and change query semantics. Handle ExpressionType.Coalesce explicitly (do not treat its left operand as null-propagating), and consider auditing any other non-null-propagating binary operators represented as SqlBinaryExpression.
admission_reason: line inside a changed hunk at the checkpoint
matchable_reason: The substance holds at the checkpoint: SqlNullabilityProcessor.cs:626-630 recurses into both operands of every SqlBinaryExpression, and ExpressionType.Coalesce is a valid SqlBinaryExpression operator (SqlExpressions/SqlBinaryExpression.cs:102), so DropNotNullChecks can drop a needed IS NOT NULL; only the method name and the 'except AndAlso/OrElse' clause describe the later revision.
thread_group_defect: ExpressionType.Coalesce is treated as null-propagating by the binary branch, so DropNotNullChecks can remove a semantically required IS NOT NULL.
